summary: Plan v2 divides the remaining task-374 work into 9 fine-grained phases (one proof obligation each where possible) across two independent tracks. LK track (A1 impR warmup -> A2 andR two-premise template -> A3 orL mirror -> A4 impL hardest -> B Craig corollary + barrel) closes the 4 remaining maeharaCore sorries and ships the public LKProof.interpolation. LJ track (C1 ljMaeharaCore leaf/one-premise/pass-through cases -> C2 orL+impL two-premise -> C3 Craig corollary + barrel) builds the new LJ/Interpolation.lean end-to-end. Phase D is the final whole-library CI sweep. LK and LJ tracks touch disjoint files and run in parallel; zero-debt policy (mark BLOCKED with lean_goal, never sorry-defer).
